plainSummary: UI packaging checks run without a sibling checkout, and releases must build the real UI asset before publishing packages.
summary: Bounded approval of UI test isolation and release ordering only. Red baseline: NESSA_UI_ROOT=/tmp/no-checkout-ui-pr1 node --test packages/ledger/dist/ui-release.smoke.test.js failed 1/2 with missing @nessalabs/ui. After migrating setup to an isolated fixture, NESSA_UI_ROOT=/tmp/no-checkout-ui-pr1 node --test packages/ledger/dist/ui-release.smoke.test.js packages/ledger/dist/ui-release.break.test.js passed 7/7 (40.1s). The smoke invokes the actual pack script without --skip-build, extracts its artifact, removes fixture sources, initializes a fresh consumer using the vendored CLI, starts the extracted Next runtime, and verifies HTTP 200 plus ledger configuration and UI/agent-stream render output. Existing all-node_modules protocol, dependency absence, package scope and version assertions remain. Final node --test --test-name-pattern=publish.yml packages/ledger/dist/ui-release.break.test.js passed 1/1, including real UI build then pack before npm publication. packages/ledger/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/ledger/tsconfig.json passed. No production code was edited by this reviewer.
killersCited: ui-release.smoke.test.ts::built release boots outside the checkout and reads the consumer ledger
ui-release.break.test.ts::shipped tree incl node_modules has zero file:/workspace: protocols
ui-release.break.test.ts::pack-ui-release fails closed when NESSA_UI_ROOT / agent-stream missing
ui-release.break.test.ts::packaged UI name/deps stay @nessalabs/* and tarball version matches ledger
ui-release.break.test.ts::publish.yml packs UI Release asset with NESSA_UI_ROOT, dist build, no --skip-build, contents:write upload
residualRisks: The minimal fixture proves packaging and extracted runtime dependency resolution, not compatibility of the real external @nessalabs/ui distribution. The previously inspected sibling distribution failed a production Next build because its client boundary contained wildcard exports. This review does not establish that the real external UI builds or approve that external dependency.
The real dependency build and full pack are release-only gates before npm publication. Neither a GitHub Release nor registry publication was executed during this review.
Fixture package prepack hooks are no-ops because compiled ledger/client files are copied in; actual core package lifecycle behavior is covered by the separate package test review.
